# GovJobs.com — लोकसेवा बिज्ञापन (Nepal government job notices)

> नेपाल लोकसेवा आयोग र सबै सरकारी कार्यालयका पछिल्ला बिज्ञापन, खरिदार, नायब सुब्बा, सुब्बा, अधिकृत र उपसचिव पदका सूचना, लिखित/अन्तिम नतिजा तथा परीक्षा केन्द्र — कोशी, मधेश, बागमती, गण्डकी, लुम्बिनी, कर्णाली, सुदूरपश्चिम प्रदेश। Latest Nepal loksewa bigyapan, kharidar, nayab subba, subba, officer and under secretary government job notices and results.

GovJobs.com lists the latest Nepal loksewa (Public Service Commission) and other
government office notices, vacancies, results and exam-center information. It is a
static, mobile-first site: the home page is a filterable list, each notice has its own
page, and every notice/filter is a stable URL so any single notice or subset is addressable.

## How to use this file
- Fetch the home page for the full list, then follow each notice's own page.
- One notice = its own page URL (see the links below).
- Filter the home page with ?q= (search), ?ty= (type) or ?prov= (province).

## Sections
- [Notices list](https://govjobscom.github.io/): all current बिज्ञापन / सूचना / नतिजा, newest first
- [RSS feed](https://govjobscom.github.io/feed.xml): machine-readable updates
- [Sitemap](https://govjobscom.github.io/sitemap.xml)
- [robots.txt](https://govjobscom.github.io/robots.txt)
